item.text:
This pass found a fifth (minor) defect in the logger package.

**Finding 5 (new, executed, minor): the logger cache ignores the monkey flag**

`logger.GetLogger` and `logger.GetMonkeyLogger` share a cache keyed only by package name (`logger/logger.go`, `getILogger`). `GetMonkeyLogger(pkg)` creates a monkey-mode `dragonboatLogger`, whose `get()` returns a null logger whenever `invariants.MonkeyTest` is false — so a later `GetLogger(pkg)` returns that same instance and all output for that package is silently suppressed in a normal build:

```
zz_audit_cache_test.go:22: GetLogger("audit-pkg") returned the monkey-mode
    logger created by the earlier GetMonkeyLogger call
--- FAIL: TestAuditMonkeyLoggerCache
```

Keying the cache on `(pkgName, monkey)` in the fix-verification copy makes the test pass. Reachability is limited — `GetMonkeyLogger` has no in-tree caller, so only external users of the monkey-test API can trigger it.

**State**

Five findings, all reproduced on the unmodified tree and all resolved by minimal patches in `audit/diag-fixes/` (which is green, race mode and memfs/chan-transport included):

- F1 `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` wakeup · F2 duplicated dropped-ReadIndex record · F3 `Update.HasUpdate` ignores `DroppedReadIndexes` · F4 channel transport factory panics from `Validate` · F5 logger cache ignores the monkey flag.

25 audit tests in total (19 negative-result/characterisation passes, 6 deliberate reproductions). [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (696 lines) carries all five findings, the evidence, fix verification, reviewed-areas catalogue, inventory and command log. The audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`.
